name: What should I expect after my log home interior gets sealed?

mainEntity.name: What should I expect after my log home interior gets sealed?

acceptedAnswer.text: A successful interior sealing job should reduce drafts, limit dust movement through joints, and help the home feel more stable and comfortable. It can also support energy efficiency, but results are best when sealing is part of an overall log-home maintenance plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: You should notice fewer drafts, less air movement through joints, and better comfort. The best results come when sealing is done as part of broader log-home maintenance.
